visualCharacteristics.structure: eyebrow + page color name/code (metadata) | large quote + avatar, attributor name and description
visualCharacteristics.layout: full-bleed page color background; stacked on mobile, 3/12 + 8/12 columns on desktop

contentPattern: Key/value rows: eyebrow | text; description | quote; attributor-image | picture; attributor-name | text; attributor-description | text. Any row may be missing. Color name and code come from page metadata (color-name, color-code, rgbhex).
